steps: Shelf (default): newest first under Today/Yesterday/Previous 7 days/Older; spine ticks 5/1/2/1 match conversation counts in family inks; title, date, conversation and branch counts; current tree marked
Title search filters case-insensitively; no match shows "No learning tree titles match."
List shows the same trees in the same order; the choice survives reload; Rename chat and Delete chat… keep their menu, confirmation and focus return
Opening a volume (click anywhere on it) opens that tree in Read; the band switcher shows its title
dark shelf: text and menu contrast >= 6.2:1; Tab reaches every volume and its menu with a paper focus ring
dark list: text and menu contrast >= 5.1:1; Tab reaches every volume and its menu with a paper focus ring
light shelf: text and menu contrast >= 6.3:1; Tab reaches every volume and its menu with a paper focus ring
light list: text and menu contrast >= 5.1:1; Tab reaches every volume and its menu with a paper focus ring
No trees: the first-run prompt and New chat show instead of an empty shelf or search
